description: 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부_우편접수용 우편번호조회 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. 검색조건에 의해 우편접수용 도로명주소 및 지번주소 상세검색 리스트 조회 시 스페이스로 구분된 검색어의 세부조건이 일치하지 않을 경우 범위검색 결과 정보를 제공하는 OPEN API 서비스 입니다. ㅇ 출력하는 항목(사용자가 응답 받게 되는 데이터 ): 주소상세목록(우편번호, 주소, 범위). Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 우정사업본부. Its tags are 경제/경영, 마케팅, 물류/유통, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2021-08-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
